description: Deposit feel: sell-on-cross + settle-after, visible per-container colored fill, and sale juice (brief sections 3.1-3.3; DESIGN-C sections 1-3). Keep the economy timing exactly (credit on cross) but defer the ball's demote so it physically lands and settles, then grows the container's cheap colored fill. Fill color matches the displayed ball color per peer (incl. colorblind). Must land first: FEAT-003's placeholder container prefab assembles a MassFillView, and the fill-color wiring lives here.
steps: NEW Assets/Game/BallPitGameplay/Containers/SettlingDeposits.cs (host-only plain C# class, < ~120 lines). Hold (id, dwellEndTime) entries in a list plus a HashSet<int> for Owns(id). Ctor injects PitAuthority and a dwell seconds (~0.6s). Register(int id) adds an entry at now+dwell. Tick(float now): for each entry, first guard authority.Active.IsActive(id) — if NOT active, drop the entry WITHOUT calling Deposit (a second Deposit on a non-active id is wrong); else demote (call authority.Deposit(id)) when now>=dwellEndTime OR authority.Active.SmoothedSpeedOf(id) is below a small stillness threshold. Flush() demotes every remaining IsActive id. Owns(id) backs the Phase-1 skip. Confirmed accessors: ActivePhysics.IsActive(int) line 99, SmoothedSpeedOf(int) line 115; PitAuthority.Deposit(int) line 294; PitAuthority.Active public readonly line 41.

EDIT Assets/Game/BallPitGameplay/Containers/DepositDriver.cs. Construct SettlingDeposits in the ctor (inject authority + dwell). In Sell(id,color,pos,container): DELETE the first line `authority.Deposit(id);`; KEEP `attribution?.Consume(id, pos, out ...)` -> `core.AddSale(color, seller, thrown, dist)` -> `container.NotifySold(pos)` byte-for-byte (same on-cross pos); append `settling.Register(id)`. In the Phase-1 active-ball loop add `if (settling.Owns(id)) continue;` so a dwelling ball is not re-sold. In AfterPhysicsStep call `settling.Tick(...)` (use the step time, e.g. Time.fixedTime or an accumulated clock) and KEEP CheckWin() as the LAST call. In Detach call settling.Flush() wrapped so a disposed world can't throw; do NOT re-run CheckWin there.

NEW Assets/Game/BallPitGameplay/Containers/MassFillView.cs implementing IContainerFillView. A single colored child MeshRenderer whose local Y scale+position lerp inside a serialized fill-volume box (local Transform/bounds) between empty and full — O(1) in sold count, scales to 100k+. NEVER drive the container root: reuse DefaultFillView's guard (dedicated child only; null-or-self pivot => no-op). SetFill(float) clamps NaN->0 and [0,1]. Add public SetColor(Color) recoloring via a MaterialPropertyBlock. OnValidate logs ONCE (editor) if the fill-volume transform is missing. Seam: IContainerFillView.SetFill (IContainerFillView.cs). No compute/GPU buffer; never reference GpuBallRenderer.

NEW (optional, ship unassigned) Assets/Game/BallPitGameplay/Containers/InstancedBallFillView.cs implementing IContainerFillView: a literal clump via its OWN Graphics.DrawMeshInstanced with its own mesh/material/MaterialPropertyBlock, visible count/stack-height tracking the fraction (cap ~a few hundred, pack density to read full). Also exposes SetColor(Color). Must NOT reference or modify GpuBallRenderer. The shaped MassFillView is the DEFAULT (owner Q1); this is the opt-in alternative.

EDIT Assets/Game/BallPitGameplay/Colors/PaletteApplier.cs. The real Apply() keeps `display` as a LOCAL (no field). ADD a private Color[] displayCache assigned at the END of Apply() (where controller.SetPalette(display) is). ADD public Color DisplayColor(int index): return displayCache[index] only when displayCache!=null and index in range; else a SAFE default (recompute from paletteService.ActiveColors(count)+ColorblindDisplay.Apply when the world count is known, else Color.white). Apply is already the handler for paletteService.Changed AND ColorblindDisplay.Changed (confirmed OnEnable), so the cache refreshes on palette/colorblind change. Read-only, additive, no SetPalette call added. ALSO add one wiring call in Awake next to the existing gameplaySession.SetPaletteService(...): gameplaySession.SetPaletteApplier(this) (new sibling setter in GameplaySession).

EDIT Assets/Game/BallPitGameplay/Economy/GameplaySession.cs. Add SetPaletteApplier(PaletteApplier) storing the reference. When the container list is built/seeded (OnPitWorldBuilt and the initial UpdateContainerFills seed), cache each container's MassFillView via GetComponentInChildren<MassFillView>() in a parallel structure keyed by container (the resolved IContainerFillView is PRIVATE in BallContainer — confirmed — so GameplaySession cannot see it). In UpdateContainerFills KEEP c.SetFill(readModel.SoldFraction(c.ColorIndex)) unchanged and, for a cached MassFillView mv, additionally call mv.SetColor(paletteApplier.DisplayColor(c.ColorIndex)). No GetComponent on the hot path; containers without a MassFillView get only SetFill (today's behavior).

NEW Assets/Game/BallPitGameplay/Containers/ContainerSaleFx.cs (optional component on a container). OnEnable subscribe to the container's EXISTING Sold C# event; OnDisable unsubscribe. On sold play a serialized placeholder AudioClip (pooled one-shot) and emit an optional ParticleSystem pop at BallContainer.IntakeWorldCenter. Add NO new events/path — reuse Sold/onSold only (confirmed on BallContainer.cs). Owner replaces clip/particle.
acceptance_criteria: In DepositDriver.Sell the economy calls (attribution.Consume with the on-cross pos, core.AddSale, container.NotifySold) are unchanged and authority.Deposit(id) is NO LONGER called there; the demote happens only via SettlingDeposits after the dwell.

A trace shows world.Store.StateTotal(Stored) != Count while any id is dwelling, so CheckWin cannot latch early; the win latches on the step the final dwell completes because Tick runs before CheckWin each step.
SettlingDeposits never calls Deposit on a non-IsActive id; a dropped/returned/grabbed id mid-dwell is removed without a second Deposit; Flush demotes all remaining IsActive ids.

MassFillView.SetFill drives only its dedicated child mesh (never the container root) and clamps NaN/[0,1]; it uses no compute/GPU buffer and never references GpuBallRenderer. SetColor recolors via a MaterialPropertyBlock.

PaletteApplier.DisplayColor(int) returns the cached post-colorblind display color after Apply, is null/range safe before the first Apply, and refreshes on paletteService.Changed and ColorblindDisplay.Changed.
GameplaySession pushes the fill color only to cached MassFillView instances, with no per-frame GetComponent and no change to the SetFill fraction path; containers with other views are unaffected.
ContainerSaleFx reuses the existing Sold event (no parallel path) and cleanly subscribes/unsubscribes.
Boundaries hold: no edits to NetPit/PitReplica/MultiplayerKit; no new replicated state or NGO codegen; collapse sim calls only pre-existing additive host APIs; GpuBallRenderer pit path untouched.
verification: Signature-trace DepositDriver.Sell before/after against the real file: only the demote moved; the three credit calls and the on-cross pos are identical.
Signature-trace SettlingDeposits against ActivePhysics (IsActive/SmoothedSpeedOf) and PitAuthority.Deposit; confirm the IsActive guard and single-Deposit invariant.
Trace the win-latch ordering in AfterPhysicsStep (Tick before CheckWin; CheckWin last) and that Detach flushes without re-checking win.

Trace MassFillView drives only a child transform (compare to DefaultFillView's root-guard) and holds no GpuBallRenderer reference; author a plain unit test for the scale/position lerp staying inside the fill-volume box.
Trace PaletteApplier.DisplayColor cache set at end of Apply + both Changed events route to Apply; trace the null/range safe default.
Trace GameplaySession caches MassFillView at build/seed and uses it read-only each frame; confirm c.SetFill unchanged and no new NetPit traffic.

Owner play-test only (cannot run here): the thrown ball visibly lands and settles then joins the fill; fill fraction matches the ledger on host AND client; fill color matches balls incl. colorblind; a plonk/pop fires per sale.
